phases.title: Fix favouriteController: pass ProductNotFoundError to next() instead of sending inline 404
phases.notes: Removed inline res.status(404).json() for ProductNotFoundError; now calls next(err) for all errors. Removed unused ProductNotFoundError import. Build passes, favouriteController tests pass.

phases.title: Fix compareController: pass error to next(err) instead of calling next() with no argument
phases.notes: Changed catch (_err) { next() } to catch (err) { next(err) } in compareController.ts. All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Fix rateLimiter: throw RateLimitError instead of plain Error so errorHandler sets Retry-After header
phases.notes: Imported RateLimitError from '../errors' and replaced `new Error(...)` with `new RateLimitError(retryAfter)` in rateLimiter.ts. All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all three endpoints behave correctly
phases.notes: All 22 tests pass (2 test files) and build succeeds. All three fixes from phases 1–3 are verified: favouriteController passes errors to next(), compareController passes err to next(err), rateLimiter throws RateLimitError.
